'''Galilei''' is a graduating male student from [[New Federation]]. He can be found discussing his graduation wishes with his teacher, '''Rhunfield'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Galilei:''' I don't want to return to the New Federation to study the Sentinel. I don't want to join the Spacetrek Collective. And I don't want to work here either.
:'''Rhunfield:''' But your training results are flawless, and your research shows remarkable foresight. What do you plan to do after graduation, Galilei?
:'''Galilei:''' I want to live like a Roya.
:'''Rhunfield:''' What? You can't be serious.
:'''Galilei:''' Professor... if my skills and my talent are just going to be tools for someone else's agenda, then I'd rather give them up.
:'''Galilei:''' If I go back to the New Federation, my research will only become another way for the capital to exploit the Sentinel.
:'''Rhunfield:''' And if I stay here? You and I both know this so-called "Research Alliance" is just a tangled web of interests, all waiting to get a slice of our work.
:'''Galilei:''' Tell me, Professor, does a true sanctuary for pure research even exist?
:'''Galilei:''' Haha, I'd rather go live as a Roya. Wouldn't be so bad living with them...
{{Dialogue End}}
